scenes.text: Imagine standing in a fifty-square-mile zone in Yellowstone National Park where you could theoretically commit a major crime and get away with it completely free.
It sounds like a wild movie plot, but this constitutional loophole is absolutely real, and it is called the Zone of Death.

Because of a strange jurisdictional overlap, the US Constitution requires any trial here to have a jury selected entirely from the people living inside this zone, but the population here is exactly zero.
Since a jury cannot constitutionally be formed, the government cannot put you on trial, so tell us in the comments if you would ever dare to camp here!
